live_readings: The 2026-09-21 observation was already made against a build carrying the fix, so both sides are true and simply out of order.
Fix part 2 is narrower than its wording suggests (e.g. it changes WHEN in page load, or removes a condition), and page-load fetching already existed from TIB-5341.
The two are not comparable - the observation was on a different store/bundle, which CONFLICT-PORTAL-001 says canonical context cannot currently determine.
